fields.name: inputs
fields.label: Inputs (JSON or YAML)
fields.help: The path and file name of the JSON or YAML file where you have defined your inference constraints.
fields.help_note: Enter the JSON or YAML contents here. Use "input": "uploaded" to reference the structure upload, or keep a bundled bio-tools://rfd3/ reference from a preset. Enter null with specification overrides for an override-only design.

fields.name: spec_input_file
fields.label: Input structure (uploaded)
fields.help: Optional PDB or mmCIF for configurations with "input": "uploaded".

fields.name: inputs_file
fields.label: Inputs file (JSON or YAML)
fields.help: The path and file name of the JSON or YAML file where you have defined your inference constraints.
fields.help_note: Choose a JSON or YAML file. Use "input": "uploaded" to reference the structure upload, or keep a bundled bio-tools://rfd3/ reference from a preset.

fields.name: input
fields.label: Input structure
fields.help: Path to and file name of PDB/CIF. Required if you provide contig+length.
fields.help_note: Choose a PDB or mmCIF file. Presets include their input structures; a new upload replaces the included file.

fields.name: contig
fields.label: Contig
fields.help: (Can only pass a contig string.) Indexed motif specification, e.g., "A1-80,10,/0,B5-12".

fields.name: unindex
fields.label: Unindex
fields.help: (Can only pass a contig string or dictionary.) Unindexed motif components, the specified residues can be anywhere in the final sequence. See Unindexing Specifics for more information.

fields.name: length
fields.label: Length
fields.help: Total design length constraint; "min-max" or int for specified length.

fields.name: ligand
fields.label: Ligand
fields.help: Ligand(s) by chemical component name (from RSCB PDB) or index.

fields.name: cif_parser_args
fields.label: CIF parser args
fields.help: Optional args to CIF loader. See CIF parser options for more information.
fields.help_note: Enter a JSON object. The local cache_dir option is not available.

fields.name: extra
fields.label: Extra
fields.help: Extra metadata (e.g., logs). Current options include sampled_contig.

fields.name: dialect
fields.label: Dialect
fields.help: 2=new (default), 1=legacy, Learn more about the legacy parsing system by looking at input_parsing.py.

fields.name: select_fixed_atoms
fields.label: Select fixed atoms
fields.help: Atoms with fixed coordinates. See the Select Fixed Atoms subsection for more information.

fields.name: select_unfixed_sequence
fields.label: Select unfixed sequence
fields.help: Where sequence can change. Default is True - all input regions have fixed sequences. Contig string input specifies components to unfix the sequence for. Dictionary inputs are allowed but not recommended.

fields.name: select_buried
fields.label: Select buried
fields.help: Selection of RASA (Relatively Accessible Surface Area) for buried, partially buried, and exposed conditioning, respectively. Only contig string and dictionary are acceptable inputs.

fields.name: select_partially_buried
fields.label: Select partially buried
fields.help: Selection of RASA (Relatively Accessible Surface Area) for buried, partially buried, and exposed conditioning, respectively. Only contig string and dictionary are acceptable inputs.

fields.name: select_exposed
fields.label: Select exposed
fields.help: Selection of RASA (Relatively Accessible Surface Area) for buried, partially buried, and exposed conditioning, respectively. Only contig string and dictionary are acceptable inputs.

fields.name: select_hbond_donor
fields.label: Select hbond donor
fields.help: Atom-wise donor/acceptor flags. Atom-wise selection of hydrogen bond donors and acceptors, respectively. Only dictionary inputs allowed. See RFdiffusion3 — Nucleic acid binder design examples for an example.

fields.name: select_hbond_acceptor
fields.label: Select hbond acceptor
fields.help: Atom-wise donor/acceptor flags. Atom-wise selection of hydrogen bond donors and acceptors, respectively. Only dictionary inputs allowed. See RFdiffusion3 — Nucleic acid binder design examples for an example.

fields.name: select_hotspots
fields.label: Select hotspots
fields.help: Atom-level or residue-level hotspots. Hotspots will typically be at most 4.5 Å to any heavy atom in the designed structure. Typically used for designing binders.

fields.name: redesign_motif_sidechains
fields.label: Redesign motif sidechains
fields.help: Fixed backbone, redesigned sidechains for motifs (input structures).

fields.name: symmetry
fields.label: Symmetry
fields.help: See Overview of Symmetry in RFD3.
fields.help_note: Enter SymmetryConfig as JSON, for example {"id": "C3", "is_symmetric_motif": true}.

fields.name: ori_token
fields.label: Ori token
fields.help: [x,y,z] origin override to control COM (center of mass) placement of designed structure.

fields.name: infer_ori_strategy
fields.label: Infer ori strategy
fields.help: "com" or "hotspots". The center of mass of the diffused region will typically be within 5Å of the ORI token. Using hotspots will place the ORI token 10Å outward from the center of mass of the specified hotspots. Using com will place the token at the center of mass of the input structure.

fields.name: plddt_enhanced
fields.label: pLDDT enhanced
fields.help: Default True. Enables pLDDT (predicted Local Distance Difference Test) enhancement.

fields.name: is_non_loopy
fields.label: Is non loopy
fields.help: Default None. If True/False, produces output structures with fewer/more loops.

fields.name: partial_t
fields.label: Partial t (angstroms)
fields.help: Noise (Å) for partial diffusion, enables partial diffusion (sets the noise level.) Recommended values are 5.0-15.0 Å. See Partial Diffusion for more information.

fields.name: allow_ligand_on_existing_chain
fields.label: Allow ligand on existing chain
fields.help: Allow the shared ligand chains used by some official input structures. This is enabled in presets that require it.

fields.name: n_batches
fields.label: Batches
fields.help: number of batches to generate per input key (default: 1).

fields.name: diffusion_batch_size
fields.label: Designs per batch
fields.help: number of diffusion samples (designs) per batch (default: 8). If n_batches=1 and diffusion_batch_size=8 then 8 designs will be generated from the inference run.

fields.name: inference_sampler.num_timesteps
fields.label: inference_sampler.num_timesteps
fields.help: diffusion timesteps for sampling (default: 200).

fields.name: inference_sampler.step_scale
fields.label: inference_sampler.step_scale
fields.help: scales diffusion step size; higher → less diverse, more designable (default: 1.5).

fields.name: low_memory_mode
fields.label: Low-memory mode
fields.help: memory-efficient tokenization mode; set True if GPU RAM is tight (default: False).

fields.name: dump_trajectories
fields.label: Save trajectories
fields.help: If True, the trajectory files are also saved to the specified output directory (default: False).

fields.name: out_dir
fields.label: Out dir
fields.help: The directory that output files from the inference run will be stored in. If the directory does not exist it will be created. This does not change how the output files are named.
fields.help_note: Enter a directory name within this run. The results page collects its files; absolute server paths are not accepted.

fields.name: specification
fields.label: Specification overrides (JSON)
fields.help: JSON overrides for the per-example InputSpecification (default: {}). For example, you can run rfd3 design inputs=null specification.length=200 for a quick debug of creating a 200-length protein.

fields.name: ckpt_path
fields.label: Ckpt path
fields.help: String containing he path and file name of the checkpoint path you want to use (default: rfd3)
fields.help_note: Use rfd3 for the configured default, or a .ckpt filename in the configured checkpoint directory.

fields.name: skip_existing
fields.label: Skip existing
fields.help: Skip designing any systems whose output files already exist in the specified out_dir (default: True).

fields.name: global_prefix
fields.label: Global prefix
fields.help: This setting allows you to change the beginning of the name of the output files from the name of the input JSON or YAML file to your own string (default: null).
fields.help_note: Leave blank for the default. Enter "" to omit the prefix. Use letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens.

fields.name: prevalidate_inputs
fields.label: Prevalidate inputs
fields.help: Check that your inputs (JSON or YAML file) are valid before running inference (default: False).

fields.name: inference_sampler.gamma_0
fields.label: inference_sampler.gamma_0
fields.help: This value (default: 0.6) influences the diversity of the designs from RFD3. A lower value increases designability but decreases diversity.

fields.name: json_keys_subset
fields.label: JSON keys subset
fields.help: Allows the user to extract only a subset of the JSON keys provided in the inputs file (default: null).

fields.name: inference_sampler.n_recycle
fields.label: inference_sampler.n_recycle
fields.help: Number of recycling iterations per diffusion step (default: null, uses the model checkpoint default of 2). Recycling allows the network to refine its predictions iteratively within each denoising step.

fields.name: inference_sampler.kind
fields.label: inference_sampler.kind
fields.help: Change this value to symmetry (default: default) to turn on symmetry mode for the inference sampler.
fields.help_note: Automatic selects the sampler from the input specification.

fields.name: inference_sampler.cfg_features
fields.label: inference_sampler.cfg_features
fields.help: The values specified (options are active_donor, active_acceptor, or ref_atomwise_rasa) are set to 0 for classifier-free guidance. Classifier-free guidance is how the diffusion model can steer the calculation towards a condition without training a separate classifier.

fields.name: inference_sampler.use_classifier_free_guidance
fields.label: inference_sampler.use_classifier_free_guidance
fields.help: If set to True, RFD3 can use classifier-free guidance to guide the system towards a condition without training a separate classifier (default: False).

fields.name: inference_sampler.cfg_t_max
fields.label: inference_sampler.cfg_t_max
fields.help: The maximum time to apply classifier-free guidance to the inference run (default: null).

fields.name: inference_sampler.cfg_scale
fields.label: inference_sampler.cfg_scale
fields.help: Controls the influence of the classifier-free guidance adjustment (default: 1.5).

fields.name: inference_sampler.center_option
fields.label: inference_sampler.center_option
fields.help: Specifies how to center the coordinates during the inference run to ensure that structures are alined around a specific point. Options include: all — (default) Uses the center of mass (COM) of all atoms motif — Uses the COM of the motif atoms with fixed coordinates diffuse — Uses the COM of all fixed coordinates that are not part of motif atoms

fields.name: inference_sampler.s_trans
fields.label: inference_sampler.s_trans
fields.help: Translational noise scale for augmentation during inference (default: 1.0).

fields.name: inference_sampler.allow_realignment
fields.label: inference_sampler.allow_realignment
fields.help: If set to True (default: False) then the noised structure can be realigned during inference based on the location of a given motif. From Issue #154: It is generally not needed to include this option, there are fewer ‘weird’ interactions with motif scaffolding when it’s set to False.

fields.name: inference_sampler.noise_scale
fields.label: inference_sampler.noise_scale
fields.help: This parameter sets the scaling for the noise during inference (default 1.003). A smaller value will lead to less noise in your system leading to less diversity in the outputs.

fields.name: inference_sampler.p
fields.label: inference_sampler.p
fields.help: Determines the ‘shape’ of the noise schedule (default: 7).

fields.name: inference_sampler.gamma_min
fields.label: inference_sampler.gamma_min
fields.help: Controls when gamma_0 is used, if t>gamma_min, gamma_0 is used as the value of gamma, which influences the diversity of the designs from RFD3.

fields.name: inference_sampler.s_jitter_origin
fields.label: inference_sampler.s_jitter_origin
fields.help: Controls the standard deviation of the Gaussian distribution that is used to ‘jitter’ the motif offset (default: 0.0, no jitter).

fields.name: cleanup_guideposts
fields.label: Cleanup guideposts
fields.help: Set to False (default: True) to save the guideposts used during inference, see Debugging recommendations for more information.

fields.name: cleanup_virtual_atoms
fields.label: Cleanup virtual atoms
fields.help: Set to False (default: True) to save information about the diffused virtual atoms used during inference. RFD3 uses virtual atoms to account for the different number of atoms in side chains during the design process. RFD3 is atom based, however the number of atoms in a residue will differ based on its side chain, which is only determined after some diffusion steps have occurred, meaning virtual atoms are necessary for those steps. See Debugging recommendations for more information.

fields.name: read_sequence_from_sequence_head
fields.label: Read sequence from sequence head
fields.help: Used during training, it is not recommended to change this setting (default: True).

fields.name: output_full_json
fields.label: Output full JSON
fields.help: Output all specification information to the JSON file that gets created for each design (default: True).

fields.name: dump_prediction_metadata_json
fields.label: Dump prediction metadata JSON
fields.help: If True, the metadata for the inference run will be included in the output JSON file (default: True).

fields.name: align_trajectory_structures
fields.label: Align trajectory structures
fields.help: Aligns the structures in the output trajectories (default: False).

web_adaptations.input: PDB/mmCIF contents or bundled asset reference instead of an arbitrary local path.
web_adaptations.atom_array_input: Internal Python AtomArray; not a web/JSON input.
web_adaptations.out_dir: Directory name inside the isolated run.
web_adaptations.ckpt_path: Filename inside the configured checkpoint directory.
web_adaptations.cif_parser_args: cache_dir is excluded because it refers to a server path.
